description: Pakistan - Climate Change is a dataset listed in Open Data Pakistan portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Gallup Pakistan. Contains data from the World Bank's data portal. There is also a consolidated country dataset on HDX. Climate change is expected to hit developing countries the hardest. Its effects, higher temperatures, changes in precipitation patterns, rising sea levels, and more frequent weather-related disasters, pose risks for agriculture, food, and water supplies. Coverage: Pakistan. The portal files it under the publisher Gallup Pakistan. Its tags are climate, climate change, energy, environment, pakistan. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2021-04-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-pk-od-portal.
